_about: Fictional episode: Gemma Whitlock, right knee sprain playing netball. N-101 Priya Shah (initial assessment), N-102 Sarah Reid (follow-up), N-103 Tom Ellis (discharge). tenantId is set by the harness.

source.label: Simulated TM3 sandbox – demo data, not affiliated with TM3

referral.name: Northgate Case Services (fictional)
referral.reason: Right knee injury playing netball on 24/08/2026.

incident.mechanism: Twisted the right knee landing from a jump at netball.

notes.author: priya
notes.subjective: Twisted R knee landing at netball 24/08/2026. Medial knee pain 6/10 on stairs. Off work since 25/08/2026.
notes.objective: Mild effusion. Tender medial joint line. Valgus stress painful, firm end feel. Knee flexion 110°.
notes.assessment: Assessment: grade I-II sprain of the right MCL, possible medial meniscus irritation.
notes.plan: Quads sets, heel slides 3 x daily. Review 1 wk.

notes.author: sarah
notes.subjective: Pain 3/10 on stairs. Back at work on reduced hours since 14/09/2026.
notes.objective: No effusion. Knee flexion 135°. Single-leg squat to 60° with control.

notes.author: tom
notes.subjective: No pain at work. Not yet back at netball.
notes.objective: Full knee range. Hop test 90% of the left side.
